risks.title: Exposure to interest rate fluctuations
risks.score_rationale: Risk positioned early in Item 7A with precise quantified language ('would result in an approximate $39.7 million change'). Material exposure documented on floorplan financing and variable-rate debt. Stable trend but high weighting for automotive sector with significant leverage.

risks.title: Foreign exchange risks on international operations
risks.score_rationale: Risk explicitly quantified with major impact ('$1.22 billion change to our revenues'). Presence confirmed in 7 countries (UK, Germany, Italy, Japan, Canada, Australia, New Zealand). Material impact language ('could be materially and adversely impacted'). Stable trend but growing geographic exposure.

risks.title: Dependence on foreign suppliers and tariffs
risks.score_rationale: Risk identified in Item 7A with enumeration of multiple factors ('differing economic conditions, changes in political climate, differing tax structures, changes in tax and tariff rates'). Material impact language ('could be materially and adversely impacted'). Emerging/increased trend amid 2025 tariff context. High macro weighting.

risks.title: Internal controls and financial reporting
risks.score_rationale: Risk positioned in Item 9A with positive conclusion ('were effective as of the end of the period'). No material changes ('no changes in our internal control'). Reassuring language and compliance attestation. Stable/attenuated trend. Moderate regulatory weighting due to no identified issues.

risks.title: Risks related to operations in the United Kingdom
risks.score_rationale: Implicit risk due to confirmed UK presence with specific credit agreement (National Westminster Bank, BMW Financial Services GB). Post-Brexit context and UK political volatility. Stable trend but increased UK geopolitical exposure. Strong geopolitical weighting.
